description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Zoho Start is seeking an associate-level Software Engineer to implement defined application features, investigate defects, and support routine software releases. The role also involves code reviews, debugging, and scoped improvements to software performance and reliability.
Software Engineer implementing defined application features, debugging software errors and release regressions, and improving performance and reliability

Responsibilities:
• Assist with database queries or data models when relevant to a feature
• Help investigate test failures or release regressions
• Use Git to manage and review changes to the codebase
• Review logs and debugging output to isolate software errors
• Participate in code reviews and apply actionable feedback
• Improve straightforward performance or reliability issues within scope
• Implement defined application features in the selected programming language

Requirements:
• Understanding of functions, data structures, and common debugging techniques
• Comfort reading API documentation and existing code
• Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks in a remote team
• Basic familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows
• Attention to code quality, security, and clear technical communication
• Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States
